title: Renewal-Focused Onboarding Playbook (30/60/90)
content:
Purpose:
This playbook is a modular, renewal-informed 30/60/90 onboarding plan designed for mid-market and enterprise customers deploying Redwood Inference. The emphasis: accelerate time-to-value while building renewal upside by the 90-day mark. Use this as the canonical template for CSMs running live onboarding engagements and for AE->CS handoffs where renewal is a KPI.

High-level goals:
- Deliver measurable first-value within 30 days (baseline prompt, latency/cost benchmark, one production route).
- Achieve steady adoption signals by day 60 (regular calls per week, usage growth, success story draft).
- Put renewal conversation and formal health pack in place by day 90.

Success metrics (sample KPIs — customize per customer):
- Time-to-first-API-call: < 48 hours from kickoff
- First-value milestone: 1 user-facing integration or automating X workflow within 30d
- Token throughput baseline: establish 95th percentile latency and cost per 1k tokens in first 30d
- Adoption: 25% month-over-month usage growth between days 30 and 90
- Renewal health score >= 80 by day 85 (see scoring below)

Stakeholders & roles:
- Customer Success Manager (CSM): lead owner for plan execution, weekly touches, renewal nudges
- Solutions Engineer (SE): technical onboarding, model selection, integration checks
- AE: renewal handoff and commercial signals; join 60-day and 90-day governance calls as needed
- Customer Technical Lead: implementation owner on customer side
- Product/Platform contact: escalation for runtime or model issues

Pre-kickoff checklist (to complete before Day 0):
- Contract & billing confirmed; access & credentials list received
- Environment access: API keys, VPC peering info, firewall allowlist documented
- Initial success criteria agreed and captured in shared doc
- Relevant stakeholders invited to kickoff meeting and calendarized

Day 0 (Kickoff) agenda:
- Introductions and roles, confirm 30/60/90 goals, decide success metrics
- Technical scoping: expected workload patterns, production traffic shape, security constraints
- Communications cadence: weekly sync, bi-weekly exec readout, Slack channel for live ops
- Immediate next steps and owners

Days 1-30 (Enable & Prove) — Outcomes: working integration + first-value
Checklist:
- SE: run sample integration with test data; confirm 1st API calls are successful
- CSM: send kickoff summary, runbook, and quick-start checklist to customer within 24h
- SE: baseline performance report (latency, cost, error rate) using representative prompts
- CSM: schedule 30-day health review; invite AE to observe if renewal window < 180 days
- CSM: capture 1–2 short customer quotes or screenshots of product flow for case building
Success signals (early):
- Daily API calls increasing (even in dev environment)
- SE reports KV cache and batching behaving as expected
- Customer able to reproduce demo flows without SE hand-holding
Common risks & mitigations:
- Risk: network/firewall blocks — Mitigation: provide standard allowlist and sample curl test immediately
- Risk: API auth confusion — Mitigation: provide step-by-step key rotate and test script

Days 31-60 (Optimize & Expand) — Outcomes: broader team adoption and perf tuning
Checklist:
- SE: implement suggested batching and caching profiles; show delta in cost/latency
- Product: propose model variant or quantization profile for production map (A/B candidate)
- CSM: run adoption play (internal champions list + office hours) to onboard two additional users/teams
- CSM: collect success stories and usage artifacts for a short internal case study
Success signals (mid):
- Monthly usage growth trajectory is positive
- Errors drop below agreed threshold; latency within SLOs for common routes
- Teams beyond initial pilot are requesting access or self-serve onboarding
Common risks & mitigations:
- Risk: Quality regression after quantization — Mitigation: register targeted eval prompts and threshold rollback policy
- Risk: Plateauing usage — Mitigation: run targeted enablement and identify blocker tickets

Days 61-90 (Stabilize & Prepare Renewal) — Outcomes: production-ready deployment and renewal-ready narrative
Checklist:
- CSM: compile 90-day health pack (usage, latency/cost, CSAT/quotes, planned roadmap asks)
- AE + CSM: map renewal timeline and decide commercial approach (expansion, committed volume, discounts)
- SE: finalize recommended runtime/instance sizing for steady-state and peak capacity
- CSM: run exec readout summarizing business impact and next-phase proposal
Success signals (late):
- Repeatable production routes with runbooks and observability dashboards active
- Exec sponsor has seen business impact and signs off on next-phase pilot/commitment

Renewal play (timing & triggers):
- Start renewal positioning 60–90 days before subscription end for annual contracts; earlier for strategic customers
- Renewal health score (components): adoption (30%), performance (20%), ROI/story (25%), support tickets & severity (15%), exec engagement (10%)
- Score buckets: >=80 green, 60–79 yellow (targeted expansion/concerns), <60 red (escalate to solutions engineering + GTM)

Renewal risk signals (examples):
- Flat or declining usage for 2+ weeks without planned seasonal cause
- Unresolved Sev2/Sev1 ticket open > 72 hours during onboarding window
- Executive inattention or lack of scheduled governance calls after day 45

Escalation path (when health score dips):
- Day 0–7 post-dip: CSM-led troubleshooting and patch plan
- Day 8–21: SE deep-dive + ticketed remediation; AE informed and ready to engage commercial levers
- Day 21+: Stand-up cross-functional remediation war room (product, infra, SE, CSM)

Communication cadence & sample templates (short):
- Kickoff follow-up (24h): subject: "[Customer] + Redwood Kickoff Summary" — include owners, 30/60/90 goals, immediate next steps and required access
- 30-day check-in: subject: "30-day health: wins + blockers" — include baseline perf, top 3 action items, proposed optimizations
- 60-day renewal nudge: subject: "Lookahead: renewal/expansion planning" — attach 60-day adoption snapshot and suggested commercial paths
- 90-day exec readout invite: subject: "Executive readout: 90-day outcomes & recommended next steps" — include ROI bullets and ask (commit, pilot expand, monthly cadence)

Templates (one-paragraph example for CSM to copy/paste):
- 30-day check-in body: "Hi [Name], pleased with progress so far — we’ve validated the core integration and seen X% improvement in latency after batching. Top priorities next: finalize runtime sizing and enable two additional internal teams. Can we sync Thursday to review?"

Low-touch vs high-touch variants:
- Low-touch (SMB/mid-market): condensed 0–30 checklist, self-serve docs, biweekly office hours, automated health emails. Renewal positioning starts 45 days before renewal and focuses on usage-driven expansion.
- High-touch (enterprise): full SE-led integrations, weekly governance, exec readouts at 60 & 90 days, tailored pilot SLOs, renewal play includes contract review and ROI workshop.

Artifacts to produce and hand off by day 90:
- 30/60/90 health pack (PDF or Confluence): KPIs, logs of issues, adoption stories, recommended next-phase sizing/costs
- Runbook (internal): steps to scale, failover, and common-ticket resolution
- Exec one-pager: business impact summary and proposed commercial ask

Practical tips & heuristics from past customers:
- Aim for a measurable, repeatable first-value that a non-technical exec can understand (e.g., "reduced content moderation review time by 40% for team X").
- Instrument early: better observability beats later firefighting. Add basic dashboards by day 14.
- Capture usage artifacts (screenshots, logs, short videos) for renewal conversations — qualitative evidence matters.

Appendix: quick scoring rubric (example weights translated to points):
- Adoption: daily active routes / target -> 0–40 points
- Performance: latency & error targets -> 0–25 points
- ROI/story: documented wins, quotes -> 0–25 points
- Support health: ticket count/severity -> 0–10 points
Total 100 points; actionable thresholds and suggested playbook steps per bucket included in linked Confluence doc.

Next steps for CSM using this template:
- Copy this doc to customer folder, fill in customer-specific KPIs, assign owners, and link to JIRA onboarding epic (example JIRA key above).
- Set recurring meetings and create a shared Slack channel for instant triage.
- Use renewal health score to drive AE engagement cadence and internal exec alerts.

End of playbook.
